anti_overlap: fd-css-design-token-reverse-engineering covers offline CSS parsing and stylesheet analysis independent of a running browser
fd-component-pattern-cataloging covers cataloging reusable component patterns and interaction states
fd-uiux-workflow-plugin covers how to package these capabilities into a Claude Code plugin
decision_lens: Findings are ranked by how much structured, machine-readable data they yield per hour of engineering investment. Anything that requires manual human interpretation at scale is deprioritized.
focus: What Playwright-based workflows can reliably extract visual design tokens and computed styles from live websites
name: fd-playwright-dom-extraction
persona: A browser automation engineer who has built production scraping pipelines for design systems. Approaches websites as structured data sources, not visual artifacts, and prioritizes reproducibility over one-off inspection.
review_areas: Assess Playwright's page.evaluate() + getComputedStyle() for extracting full color palettes, font stacks, and spacing values from CSS custom properties and computed styles
Evaluate Chrome DevTools Protocol CSS coverage and style profiling endpoints (CDP CSS.getMatchedStylesForNode, CSS.getComputedStyleForNode) for bulk token extraction
Investigate page.accessibility() and the AX tree as a structural proxy for information hierarchy and semantic layout
Examine screenshot-diff workflows: full-page and component-level screenshots at multiple viewport widths to capture responsive breakpoints
Assess viability of a Playwright script that walks the DOM, clusters elements by computed role/tag/class, and emits a JSON token manifest
Identify which target site categories (SPA vs SSR, shadow DOM, canvas-heavy) break naive extraction and what fallback strategies exist
success_hints: A working Playwright script approach that emits color-palette and spacing-scale JSON from any public URL
Clear taxonomy of what is reliably extractable today vs what requires human curation
task_context: The Shadow Work Tauri/React desktop app needs design inspiration from complex data-visualization and simulation UIs. Goal is automated extraction of design tokens and component patterns from reference sites using tools available to an AI coding agent in 2026.
